simple.meaning: צְלָצַל (tsᵉlâtsal) is a Hebrew animal word meaning “a clatter , i.e. (abstractly) whirring (of wings); (concretely) a cricket ; also a harpoon (as rattling ),a cymbal (as clanging ).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
